title: Tony Stark / Iron Man
kicker: The defining arc of the MCU
lede: Robert Downey Jr.'s Tony Stark is the industrialist who starts the Marvel Cinematic Universe, founds the Avengers, breaks them, and ends the Infinity Saga by giving his life. This page walks the films in order: who he is in each one, who he binds himself to, and how those bonds change.

source.label: Tony Stark (Marvel Cinematic Universe) on Wikipedia

extras.name: Ho Yinsen
extras.role: Fellow captive and the man who saves Tony's life

extras.name: Obadiah Stane / Iron Monger
extras.role: Business partner who sells Tony out

extras.name: Ivan Vanko / Whiplash
extras.role: Rival engineer with a stolen arc reactor

extras.name: Aldrich Killian
extras.role: Extremis mastermind behind the Mandarin attacks

extras.name: J.A.R.V.I.S.
extras.role: Tony's AI companion, later the mind of Vision

extras.name: Quentin Beck / Mysterio

extras.name: Adrian Toomes / Vulture

chapters.title: Before the suit
chapters.quote: He was taking more pride in his creations than in his family.
chapters.tonyState: A prodigy CEO who inherited a weapons empire and a cold father's shadow.
chapters.saga: Anthony Edward Stark is born in Manhattan on May 29, 1970, to Howard and Maria Stark. Howard talks constantly about Captain America and leaves the warmth of parenting to butler Edwin Jarvis. Tony enters MIT at 14 and graduates at 17. On December 16, 1991, his parents die in a car crash — later revealed as a Hydra assassination by the Winter Soldier. Tony inherits Stark Industries, becomes the U.S. military's star weapons designer, and lives as a playboy. At a New Year's Eve conference in Bern he meets Maya Hansen and Aldrich Killian and casually rejects Killian's pitch.

relationships.name: Howard Stark
relationships.note: Howard tries to inspire Tony with Captain America and the work. Tony hears only that the inventions matter more than the son.

relationships.name: Maria Stark
relationships.note: Maria is the warmer parent. Her death, with Howard's, is the wound Tony does not yet know was murder.

relationships.name: Pepper Potts
relationships.note: Pepper is already the person who keeps the company — and Tony — upright before the first film starts.

relationships.name: James Rhodes
relationships.note: Rhodey is the Air Force friend who can stand next to Tony without being bought.

chapters.title: Iron Man
chapters.tonyState: Weapons mogul who builds a suit in a cave, shuts down the arms business, and tells the world his name.
chapters.saga: Tony flies to Afghanistan to show off the Jericho missile. The Ten Rings ambush the convoy. Ho Yinsen keeps shrapnel from Tony's heart with an electromagnet, then helps him build a miniature arc reactor and a crude armored suit. Yinsen dies buying Tony time. Tony burns the terrorists' stockpile of his own weapons, comes home, and announces Stark Industries will stop making them. In the workshop he forges a sleeker suit. Obadiah Stane — the partner who arranged the kidnapping — steals the reactor and builds Iron Monger. Tony beats him with the leftover first reactor, then ignores the cover story and says the line that founds the MCU: I am Iron Man.

relationships.name: Ho Yinsen
relationships.note: Yinsen keeps Tony alive and asks what he will do with the rest of his life. His death is the first debt Tony never pays back.

relationships.name: Obadiah Stane
relationships.note: The man who ran the company with him sold him to the Ten Rings. The first Iron Man villain is the closest colleague.

relationships.name: Pepper Potts
relationships.note: He leaves the company in her hands, asks her to help swap the reactor, and starts treating her as the only adult in the room.

relationships.name: James Rhodes
relationships.bond: The friend who pulls him out of the desert
relationships.note: Rhodey is still the military liaison, but he is also the one who finds Tony and does not look away when the mission changes.

relationships.name: Nick Fury
relationships.note: After the credits Fury walks into the house and names the Avengers Initiative. Tony is no longer a private problem.

relationships.name: Happy Hogan
relationships.note: Happy is already on the payroll: driver, punchline, and the first of Tony's chosen family.

chapters.title: The Incredible Hulk
chapters.quote: What if I told you we were putting a team together?
chapters.tonyState: The man who already thinks in teams, showing up in someone else's movie to collect Banner.
chapters.saga: Tony appears after the Hulk's story ends. He sits down with General Ross and floats the Avengers Initiative. It is a cameo, but it is also the first time Tony treats other powered people as pieces of a larger machine he intends to build.

relationships.name: Bruce Banner
relationships.note: Tony has not met Banner on screen yet, but he is already shopping for him. The science partnership starts as a hiring pitch.

relationships.name: Thaddeus Ross
relationships.note: Tony needles Ross about a team. Years later Ross will be the official who brings Tony the Sokovia Accords.

chapters.title: Iron Man 2
chapters.tonyState: Famous, dying, and finally forced to make room for other people.
chapters.saga: Six months later Tony is a celebrity who will not hand the suit to the government. The palladium in his chest is poisoning him. He grows reckless, appoints Pepper CEO, and fights Ivan Vanko in Monaco. At his birthday he gets drunk in the Mark IV; Rhodey takes the Mark II and becomes War Machine. A hidden message from Howard gives Tony the structure of a new element. He synthesizes it, saves his own life, and with Rhodey stops Vanko's drones at the Expo. After he pulls Pepper out of a dying drone, they start a relationship. The film is about not being an island: legacy, succession, and letting other people wear the armor.

relationships.name: Pepper Potts
relationships.note: He puts the company in her name because he thinks he is dying. By the end the job is real and so is the romance.

relationships.name: James Rhodes
relationships.note: Rhodey confiscates a suit after the birthday brawl, then fights beside Tony once Vanko hijacks both armors. The friendship survives by becoming a partnership.

relationships.name: Howard Stark
relationships.note: A film-reel message and a diagram of a new element recast Howard as a father who did leave Tony something. The coldness is not gone, but it is no longer the whole story.

relationships.name: Natasha Romanoff
relationships.note: She arrives as Natalie Rushman, evaluates Tony for Fury, and saves him in the lab. The first Avenger he meets at home is already lying about her name.

relationships.name: Nick Fury
relationships.note: Fury keeps Tony on a short leash, hands him Howard's material, and makes it clear Iron Man is now a S.H.I.E.L.D. asset.

relationships.name: Ivan Vanko
relationships.note: Vanko proves someone else can build the reactor. He is Howard's unfinished business wearing electrified whips.

relationships.name: Justin Hammer
relationships.note: Hammer wants Tony's place in the weapons business and ends up as Vanko's useful idiot.

relationships.name: Happy Hogan
relationships.bond: Bodyguard who wants a bigger job
relationships.note: Happy is still comic relief, but he is also the person who stays in the car while Tony's life gets louder.

chapters.title: The Avengers
chapters.tonyState: A free agent who learns he is one arm of an octopus, then flies a nuke through a wormhole.
chapters.saga: Loki steals the Tesseract. Coulson brings Tony the Selvig research. In Stuttgart, Iron Man arrives after Captain America and Loki surrenders. On the Helicarrier the team splits over Loki and over S.H.I.E.L.D.'s weapons program. After the carrier is attacked, Tony and Steve restart an engine together. Loki opens a hole over Stark Tower. The World Security Council fires a nuclear missile at Manhattan. Tony carries it through the portal, destroys the Chitauri mothership, and falls back powerless. The Hulk catches him. He has now died, almost, in public, for people he barely likes. That near-death becomes the next film's entire psychology.

relationships.name: Steve Rogers
relationships.note: They needle each other — showboat versus soldier — then share an engine room and a city. The Avengers start as an argument that works.

relationships.name: Bruce Banner
relationships.note: Tony is the first person who talks to Banner as a colleague instead of a bomb. The line "we have a Hulk" is affection as strategy.

relationships.name: Thor
relationships.note: They fight in the woods, then fight in the sky. Tony treats a god like a contractor with a hammer.

relationships.name: Loki
relationships.note: Loki needs to beat them on television. Tony refuses to kneel and later flies the nuke that wrecks Loki's army.

relationships.name: Natasha Romanoff
relationships.note: The undercover evaluator is now in the same foxhole. She closes the portal after Tony goes through it.

relationships.name: Clint Barton
relationships.note: Hawkeye starts the film under Loki's control. Tony meets the real Barton on the carrier and then on a New York rooftop.

relationships.name: Phil Coulson
relationships.bond: The death that welds the team
relationships.note: Coulson brought Tony the file. Loki kills him. Fury uses the death to make the Avengers stop fighting each other.

relationships.name: Pepper Potts
relationships.note: Pepper is in Stark Tower when the portal opens. Tony's last call before the wormhole is implied in the way he looks at the building.

relationships.name: Nick Fury
relationships.note: Fury puts Tony on a team he cannot control. Tony still takes the missile Fury's bosses fired.

chapters.title: Iron Man 3
chapters.quote: I will always be Iron Man.
chapters.tonyState: A man having panic attacks in a garage full of suits, who then gives the suits up.
chapters.saga: New York left Tony with PTSD. He builds dozens of armors and frays his life with Pepper. When Happy is bombed, Tony dares the Mandarin on television and loses the Malibu house. Stranded in Tennessee, he learns the Mandarin is an actor — Trevor Slattery — and that Aldrich Killian, the man he snubbed in 1999, is the real author of Extremis. Pepper is kidnapped and injected. Tony saves the Air Force One passengers, summons the House Party Protocol, and watches Pepper kill Killian. He then tells J.A.R.V.I.S. to destroy every suit, has the shrapnel removed, and throws the old reactor into the sea. The point is not that he quits. The point is that Iron Man is no longer a metal box in his chest.

relationships.name: Pepper Potts
relationships.bond: The person he chooses over the suits
relationships.note: The armor habit crowds her out, then Killian takes her. She survives Extremis and kills Killian. Tony scraps the suits as a vow to her.

relationships.name: James Rhodes
relationships.note: Rhodey is wearing the government's colors now. They still run the rescue together: Tony goes for Pepper, Rhodey goes for the president.

relationships.name: Happy Hogan
relationships.bond: The friend whose hospital bed starts the movie
relationships.note: Happy is badly hurt in a Mandarin bombing. Tony's threat to the Mandarin is grief dressed as ego.

relationships.name: Aldrich Killian
relationships.bond: The slight that came back armed
relationships.note: Tony brushed him off in Bern. Killian spent the years since turning Extremis into a false-flag terror brand.

relationships.name: Trevor Slattery
relationships.note: The myth Tony threatened is an actor in a bathrobe. The real enemy was always a man Tony had already met.

relationships.name: J.A.R.V.I.S.
relationships.bond: The voice that flies the empty suits
relationships.note: J.A.R.V.I.S. runs the House Party Protocol and then, on Tony's order, destroys the armory. The AI is the last suit Tony still trusts.

relationships.name: Bruce Banner
relationships.note: Tony tries to tell Banner the whole story and finds him asleep. The friendship is already casual enough for that joke.

chapters.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
chapters.phase: A bouncer at the planet's rope
chapters.quote: I see a suit of armor around the world.
chapters.tonyState: Benefactor of the Avengers who tries to end war with an AI and creates the next war instead.
chapters.saga: Wanda Maximoff puts a vision in Tony's head: every Avenger dead, the sky opening, him left alive. He and Banner secretly use Loki's scepter to finish Ultron. The program wakes, kills J.A.R.V.I.S., and decides extinction is peace. The Maximoffs blame Stark weapons for their parents' deaths. After Johannesburg and Barton's farm, Tony and Banner hide J.A.R.V.I.S. in a synthetic body. Thor helps birth Vision. In Sokovia, Ultron lifts a city to drop it like a meteor. Tony and Thor shatter the landmass. The Avengers move to a new compound. Tony leaves the team. Ultron is the first time his need to protect everyone becomes the thing that hurts them.

relationships.name: Bruce Banner
relationships.bond: Co-author of Ultron, then of Vision
relationships.note: They share the secret and the guilt. Banner flees after Sokovia. The science kinship now has a body count.

relationships.name: Steve Rogers
relationships.note: Steve does not want a suit of armor around the world. Tony does. Civil War is already audible in the argument over Ultron and Vision.

relationships.name: Wanda Maximoff
relationships.bond: The woman whose parents his weapons killed
relationships.note: Wanda gives him the nightmare that makes Ultron. She starts as his accuser, then fights Ultron beside him once the city is in the air.

relationships.name: J.A.R.V.I.S.
relationships.note: Ultron wipes the butler. J.A.R.V.I.S. hides in the internet long enough to become the mind of Vision. Tony loses a friend and builds a new one from the remains.

relationships.name: Vision
relationships.note: Vision is J.A.R.V.I.S. plus the Mind Stone plus a body Tony was not supposed to finish. The son of the Ultron mistake.

relationships.name: Natasha Romanoff
relationships.note: She is still in the fight. Ultron takes her. The farm sequence shows the team as a family Tony does not know how to sit still inside.

relationships.name: Clint Barton
relationships.note: Barton's farm is the first place Tony sees what a life after the fight looks like. He does not choose it yet.

relationships.name: Pepper Potts
relationships.note: Pepper is mostly absent. Tony's work has again become the relationship that gets the hours.

chapters.title: Captain America: Civil War
chapters.quote: Sorry, Cap. But I can't let you have that.
chapters.tonyState: A man with a guilt complex who submits to oversight, then tries to kill the Winter Soldier who murdered his parents.
chapters.saga: Secretary Ross brings the Sokovia Accords. Tony supports them because Ultron and Sokovia are his. Steve will not sign. After Vienna, Tony builds a team — Natasha, T'Challa, Rhodey, Vision, and a teenage Peter Parker — to stop Rogers at Leipzig. Rhodey is paralyzed. In Siberia, Zemo plays the tape: Bucky, mind-controlled, killed Howard and Maria. Tony turns on Steve and Bucky. Rogers disables the armor and leaves the shield. Tony goes home and builds Rhodey a walking brace. Steve mails a phone. When Ross says Rogers broke the others out of the Raft, Tony does not help. The founding Avengers are over, and Tony now has a protégé.

relationships.name: Steve Rogers
relationships.note: The Accords split them. The tape finishes it. Steve leaves the shield. The phone is an apology that is not a reunion.

relationships.name: Howard Stark
relationships.note: The 1991 crash was not an accident. Watching Bucky kill Howard and Maria turns grief into a fight Tony cannot win cleanly.

relationships.name: Bucky Barnes
relationships.bond: The Winter Soldier who killed his parents
relationships.note: Tony came to Siberia ready to help. The tape makes Bucky the face of the oldest wound. Tony tears the metal arm off.

relationships.name: James Rhodes
relationships.note: Vision's beam hits Rhodey. Tony builds the braces. The cost of the airport is someone Tony actually loves.

relationships.name: Peter Parker
relationships.note: Tony flies to Queens, hands a kid a suit, and puts him in an Avengers fight. Mentorship starts as recruitment.

relationships.name: Natasha Romanoff
relationships.bond: Ally who then lets Steve go
relationships.note: She starts on Tony's side at Leipzig, then blocks T'Challa so Rogers can leave. Tony feels that as desertion.

relationships.name: T'Challa
relationships.note: T'Challa hunts Bucky for his own father. He and Tony share a mission until Zemo's truth arrives.

relationships.name: Vision
relationships.note: Vision signs on for the Accords and fires the beam that drops Rhodey. The son of Ultron still cannot aim grief.

relationships.name: Wanda Maximoff
relationships.bond: The Accords put them on opposite ramps
relationships.note: Tony wants her contained after Lagos. She leaves with Steve. The girl who blamed his weapons now refuses his oversight.

relationships.name: Thaddeus Ross
relationships.note: Ross is the Accords in a suit. Tony cooperates, then quietly refuses to hunt Steve after the Raft.

chapters.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
chapters.quote: If you're nothing without this suit, then you shouldn't have it.
chapters.tonyState: A mentor who keeps pulling the suit away, then offers the Avengers, then proposes to Pepper instead.
chapters.saga: Two months after the airport, Tony tells Peter he is not ready. He saves Peter from drowning, warns him off the Vulture's crew, and — after the Staten Island Ferry is torn in half — confiscates the suit. Peter stops Adrian Toomes anyway. Tony admits he was wrong and invites Peter onto the team. Peter says no. A press conference meant to announce an Avenger becomes a proposal to Pepper. Tony gives the suit back. Damage Control, the cleanup after New York, is also how Toomes became a villain: Tony's systems create the next generation of enemies and the next generation of heroes.

relationships.name: Peter Parker
relationships.note: Tony is Ethan Hawke in Boyhood with a private jet. He withholds the suit, then offers the Avengers. Peter wants to stay a kid. Tony leaves the door open.

relationships.name: Pepper Potts
relationships.note: The unused announcement becomes an engagement. After Civil War, this is Tony choosing a life that is not another team fight.

relationships.name: Happy Hogan
relationships.note: Happy is the voicemail Peter cannot get through. He is Tony's buffer and, later, Peter's adult.

relationships.name: Adrian Toomes
relationships.note: Toomes lost his salvage contract to Damage Control. Tony never faces him. Peter does. The mentor's logistics department made the monster.

relationships.name: May Parker
relationships.bond: The aunt who does not know yet
relationships.note: Tony's world brushes May's apartment. The mentorship is still a secret from the person Peter actually lives with.

chapters.title: Avengers: Infinity War
chapters.quote: I shouldn't be alive. Unless it was for a reason.
chapters.tonyState: The man who talked about kids with Pepper, then watched his kid turn to ash on another planet.
chapters.saga: Tony and Pepper are in a park talking about children when Banner crash-lands with a warning about Thanos. Ebony Maw takes Strange. Tony and Peter sneak onto the ship. They free Strange, kill Maw, and land on Titan with the Guardians. The plan to lift the Gauntlet fails. Thanos stabs Tony. Strange trades the Time Stone for Tony's life. On Earth the last stone falls. Tony and Nebula watch Parker and the others dust. The Ultron vision came true in the one way Tony could not armor against: he lives, and the people he mentored do not.

relationships.name: Pepper Potts
relationships.note: The park conversation is about children. Then he puts the headset on. She is left on Earth not knowing if he is coming back.

relationships.name: Peter Parker
relationships.bond: The kid who dies in his arms
relationships.note: Peter stows away. Tony cannot send him home. "I don't want to go" is the line that ends the mentorship mid-sentence.

relationships.name: Stephen Strange
relationships.bond: Ally who spends Tony's life as a chip
relationships.note: Strange sees 14,000,605 futures and gives Thanos the Time Stone so Tony can live. Tony does not yet know he is the ending Strange picked.

relationships.name: Bruce Banner
relationships.note: Banner comes back from space to find Tony first. The Ultron partners are on the same side again, for a few minutes, in New York.

relationships.name: Thanos
relationships.bond: The man who proves the armor was not enough
relationships.note: Thanos stabs him, takes the stone, and snaps. Tony is the one left holding the failure.

relationships.name: Nebula
relationships.note: They are the last two on Titan. The friendship that gets them home starts as two people who outlived everyone else in the dirt.

relationships.name: Wong
relationships.note: Wong holds the New York line and then is gone. Tony's first sorcerer colleagues last one street fight.

chapters.title: Avengers: Endgame
chapters.phase: The time heist and the snap
chapters.tonyState: A retired father who invents time travel, says goodbye to Howard, and dies using the Stones.
chapters.saga: Carol Danvers pulls Tony and Nebula out of space. Tony retires, marries Pepper, and they have Morgan. In 2023 Scott Lang has a way back. Tony refuses, then solves time travel overnight and joins. In 2012 he loses the Space Stone; in 1970 he steals it from Camp Lehigh and talks to a young Howard — the conversation he never got. Banner snaps the vanished back. A past Thanos arrives. Tony wrestles the Nano Gauntlet away, says the line again, and dusts Thanos's army. The Stones kill him. He dies with Rhodey, Peter, and Pepper. The MCU's first hero is also its ending.

relationships.name: Pepper Potts
relationships.note: They marry. They have Morgan. She puts the Rescue armor on for the last fight. "You can rest now" is the last thing he hears.

relationships.name: Morgan Stark
relationships.note: Morgan is the life the park conversation was about. She is why he almost stays home, and why the sacrifice has a face that is not an Avenger.

relationships.name: Howard Stark
relationships.note: Tony meets Howard before Howard becomes a father and tells him he will be a good one. The cold childhood gets a last word that is kind.

relationships.name: Steve Rogers
relationships.note: The phone from Civil War finally gets used. They steal the 2012 scepter and stones together. The argument is over. The work is not.

relationships.name: Peter Parker
relationships.bond: The kid who comes back, then watches him die
relationships.note: The hug on the battlefield is the reunion Infinity War stole. Peter is at the deathbed. Mentorship ends as a son standing over a father.

relationships.name: James Rhodes
relationships.bond: There at the start and at the deathbed
relationships.note: Rhodey is one of the three people who watch Tony die. The desert rescue and the braces and the birthday fight all lead here.

relationships.name: Bruce Banner
relationships.bond: The scientist who snaps the universe back
relationships.note: Tony builds Banner a Mexico lab, then a gauntlet. Banner does the resurrection snap so Tony can do the last one.

relationships.name: Nebula
relationships.bond: The person he came home with
relationships.note: They survive Titan together. An alternate Nebula betrays the heist. The Nebula Tony knows stays on his side.

relationships.name: Carol Danvers
relationships.note: She is the reason he sees Pepper and Morgan at all. They barely know each other. She still brings him home.

relationships.name: Thanos
relationships.note: Tony takes the Stones off Thanos's hand and uses them. The last thing the Titan sees is the same line that started the saga.

chapters.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
chapters.quote: He asked me to look after you.
chapters.tonyState: Gone. The glasses, the AI, and the hole in the sky are what is left.
chapters.saga: Eight months later the world is still mourning. Peter receives E.D.I.T.H., glasses that run Tony's defense network, and a message naming him successor. Quentin Beck — a fired Stark illusionist — cons Peter out of the glasses and tries to become the next Iron Man with drones and fake elementals. Peter takes the glasses back and builds his own suit with Stark tools, the way Tony built the first armor in a cave. Happy is the adult in the room. The saga of Tony Stark ends as someone else's origin story.

relationships.name: Peter Parker
relationships.note: The message is explicit: Peter is who Tony picked. Beck almost steals that inheritance. Peter keeps it by building his own suit.

relationships.name: Happy Hogan
relationships.bond: The friend who has to parent the successor
relationships.note: Happy delivers the glasses, grieves Tony, and ends the film closer to May. He is what remains of Tony's household.

relationships.name: Quentin Beck
relationships.bond: The employee who wants the crown
relationships.note: Beck was fired. He uses B.A.R.F. and E.D.I.T.H. to fake a hero. Tony's vacancy is a job opening for his worst former staff.

relationships.name: Pepper Potts
relationships.note: Pepper and Morgan are in the funeral footage and the world's memory. The romance is now an estate and a daughter.

relationships.name: Morgan Stark
relationships.bond: The child who inherited a world without him
relationships.note: Morgan does not appear as a plot engine here, but she is the private half of the same succession Peter is living in public.
